# General instructions
When writing code modification, never proceed with option 1 and option 2 etc. Always proceed with single option(RECOMMENDED suggestion) at a time ask user if they want alternate option. This is to ensure same file is not modified multiple times for different approaches.


## Writing codes best practices
When writing code, we should always make code more understandable without using excessive comments and bloating it with information for other developers to go through it. Simple and clean code is always preferred with method and variable names self-explanatory of their purpose. Avoid writing complex one-liner code which is difficult to understand. Always break down complex logic into smaller methods with proper naming so that it is easy to read and understand and maintain in future.
